notes: DiscoFlate v3.84.0 — 🃏 One card, one corner, one message. Competition, Bonus Round and Broadcast join the Poll Viewer as on-screen cards, all four drawn by the same renderer so they can't drift apart. A poll, a competition and a bonus round can no longer run at the same time — whichever you try second is refused and told what's in the way. A broadcast fired while one is running WAITS for the slot instead of being refused, then posts and takes the card. FIXED: a command used to speak three or four times — its block's message rows, then its reply, then its event lines, each its own post seconds apart. One invocation is now one message (one embed when rich output is on). Also fixes an action-driven command posting a bare "[name · user]" header with nothing under it, because the header made an empty reply look non-empty.
